events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York, in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, hundreds of thousands gathered in a field for three days of peace, love, and music. The legendary Woodstock Festival truly defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Forty-nine years since Elvis Presley left the building for the last time, but his music lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering the enduring legacy and powerful voice of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true guitar hero. Jimi Hendrix's influence on music is still felt across generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us the iconic 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Big Day
angles.copy: Sending a big shout out to Chrissie Hynde, celebrating her 75th birthday today. Still rocking after all these years!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The legendary frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001, and released it on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. Remember your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Celebration
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage on screen.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend and Monty Python star, John Cleese, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending the happiest of 87th birthdays to the brilliant John Cleese. A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Milestone
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Double album, double the genius.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true showman. Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, whose voice still electrifies.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflection
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal moment in their incredible evolution.
